caption:
₹8 lakh small car: how much of that price is GST?

Since 22 Sep 2025, small cars (up to 4 m, petrol up to 1,200 cc, diesel up to 1,500 cc) pay 18% GST with no cess.
On an illustrative ₹8 lakh ex-showroom price, about ₹1,22,034 of it is GST.
Longer cars or bigger engines sit in the 40% slab: on the same ₹8 lakh that's about ₹2,28,571.

Did you know the car's size changes the tax this much?

Sources: an auto news site's GST explainer (Sep 2025) and a business-advisory site's GST reform note (Sep 2025); the ₹ figures are our own illustrative arithmetic.
